question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker as player_id,
        b.match_id,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
        AND b.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
),
player_total_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) as match_runs
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id, match_id FROM player_match
    WHERE match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
),
player_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(pr.match_runs), 0) as total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_matches pm
    LEFT JOIN player_total_runs pr ON pm.player_id = pr.player_id AND pm.match_id = pr.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_avg_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        total_runs,
        matches_played,
        total_runs * 1.0 / matches_played as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_agg
    WHERE matches_played > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC) as rn
    FROM player_avg_calc
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(r.avg_runs_per_match, 2) as avg_runs_per_match,
    ROUND(r.total_runs * 1.0 / (r.matches_played + 1), 2) as batting_average
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rn <= 5
ORDER BY r.avg_runs_per_match DESC
